step1.title: Phendula
step1.body: Chitha imizuzu elishumi noMandi. Imibuzo emihle engamashumi amahlanu anesithandathu malunga nokuziva kwakho — ngolwimi lwakho.

step2.title: Thunga ingubo yakho
step2.body: Impendulo nganye sisicwili. Ndawonye ziba yiMandi Blanket yakho — imephu ebonakalayo apho ukhoyo.

step3.title: Yifumane ihlelo lakho
step3.body: Amanqaku, izixhobo, noogqirha abathetha ulwimi lwakho — kunikezelwe ngokwemfundo oyabelaneyo.

peek.title: Yakhiwe ngeempendulo zakho.
peek.caption: Le yindlela ukugqibezelwa kubonakala — isicwili ngasinye yinxalenye yebali lakho.

read.title: Inyaniso Nge-HRT
read.body: Imfundo elula. Iminyaka engamashumi amabini anesithathu yokungaqondi, isombululwe.

find.title: Fumana ugqirha
find.body: Oogqirha abaqeqeshelwe i-HRT abathetha ulwimi lwakho — kuMzantsi Afrika uphela.

gather.title: Iziganeko zaMandi
gather.body: Iimboniso, ii-Q&A, neeMandi Cafés. I-menopause yayiyimfihlo — le iyile ehlanganisayo.

honour.title: Hlonipha Oomama
honour.body: Ihlonipho ephilayo. Abafazi imizimba yabo ebumba unyango esinalo namhlanje.

built.line1: Iprojekthi evela kwiMrsKing Productions, yasekwa nguHermi King.
built.line2: Isikhokelo sezonyango sivela kuDr Funeka Bango.
built.line3: Iyaphehlelelwa kunye nedokhumentari yekykNET ethi Meer as Warm Gloede ngo-Agasti 2026.

consent.title: Ngaphambi kokuba siqale — izinto ezimbalwa ekufuneka uzazi.
consent.body: Imibuzo elandelayo malunga nempilo yakho nokuziva kwakho. Sisebenzisa iimpendulo zakho kuphela ukukunika indlela yakho yomntu ngamnye. Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho. Asabelani naye nabani ngaphandle kwemvume yakho. Unokucima idatha yakho nangaliphi na ixesha. Le platform iyahambelana noMthetho Wokukhuselwa Kolwazi Lomntu (POPIA).

body.description: Indlela umzimba wakho oziva ngayo ngaphandle ukuya ngaphakathi.

urogenital.title: Umjikelo wakho nempilo yangasese
urogenital.description: Utshintsho olungafane luthethwe kodwa lubaluleke kakhulu.

mindset.title: Indlela ocinga kwaye uziva ngayo ngale nto
mindset.description: Imibuzo embalwa yokugqibela — ngawe, kungekuko iimpawu zakho.

q3.hint: Lisetyenziswa nobude bakho ukubala i-BMI yelaph yakho.

q4.text: Iitsuku zakho zatshintsha okanye zayeka nini?

q5.text: Ngaba ugqirha wakhe wathetha nawe nge-menopause okanye ii-hormone?

q7.text: Iingxaki zenkumbulo — ukulibala amagama, oonobumba, okanye apho ubeka izinto khona

q8.text: Ukuxakeka kukufumana amagama — uyazi ukuba ufuna ukuthini kodwa awulifumani igama

q9.text: Ukuncipha kokwenza imisebenzi emininzi — kunzima ukulawula okungaphezu kwento enye ngexesha

q10.text: Utshintsho lweemvakalelo — uziva uphezulu nasezantsi ngaphandle kwesizathu

q11.text: Ukucaphuka — ukuqumba okanye ukuba nomsindo lula kunesiqhelo

q12.text: Ukuziva unexhala okanye ukhathazekile ngaphezu kwesiqhelo

q13.text: Ukuziva uthantamise, ulungile nje, okanye udanile

q14.text: Ukungabi nampembelelo — kunzima ukufumana amandla okanye umnqweno wokwenza izinto owawuzithanda

q15.text: Ukuzixabisa kakubi — uziva ungenazithembelo okanye ungaxabisanga njengakuqala

q16.text: Ukungaziva njengawe — ukungamazi umntu obube nguye
q16.hint: Lo mbuzo uchukumisa abafazi abaninzi okokuqala. Themba oko ukuvayo.

q17.hint: Ungaphendula ngokunyaniseka. Ukuba uxakekile, uMandi uya kubeka inkxaso kwihlelo lakho ngokukhawuleza.

q18.text: Ukushushuziswa — amaza esiquphe obushushu emzimbeni wakho

q19.text: Ukubila ebusuku — ukuvuka ufuminisile okanye ushushu

q20.text: Iingxaki zokulala — kunzima ukulala okanye ukuhlala ulele

q21.text: Ukubetha kwentliziyo — intliziyo ibaleke okanye ibethe ngokungaqhelekanga

q22.text: Iintloko ezibuhlungu okanye i-migraine — rhoqo okanye buhlungu ngaphezulu kunangaphambili

q24.text: Imilenze engaphumliyo — umnqweno ongathokomeli wokuhambisa imilenze, ingakumbi ebusuku

q26.text: Iintlungu zamalungu — iintlungu, ukuqina, okanye ukudumba kumalungu

q28.text: Igxalaba elingakwaziyo ukuhambahamba — iintlungu okanye ukunqunyanyiswa kokuhambahamba egxalabeni
q28.hint: Uphawu lwe-menopause olungaqondwa kakuhle. Ukuba ngulo wena, awucingi nje.

q29.text: Ukudinwa namandla aphantsi — udiniwe nokuba uphumlile

q32.text: Utshintsho lolusu — ukoma, ukuvuza, okanye utshintsho lwesimbo solusu

q34.text: Amehlo omileyo — ukoma okuqhubekayo, ukucaphukisa, okanye umbono ofiphileyo

q35.text: Utshintsho kwiitsuku zakho — zinzima, zilula, zide, zifutshane, okanye azingafiki rhoqo kunangaphambili

q38.text: Iingxaki zesidlele — ungxamisekile, ulutshazwa, okanye uya rhoqo, kuquka ebusuku

q41.text: Ukuncipha kokunyamezela utywala — iiglasi ezimbini ezazilungile zazi zizovakala njengezine
q41.hint: Lo ngumbuzo owenza abafazi bathi: 'linda — yi-menopause leyo?'

q42.text: Ii-allergies ezintsha okanye ezimbi ngakumbi — i-hay fever, ukungayamkeli ukutya, okanye ukucaphukisa ongazange wabanako

q43.text: Ukungonyaniseki kwesimo sempilo isiqhelekileyo — i-asthma, i-migraine, isimo se-autoimmune, okanye okufanayo
q43.hint: Ukuba yintandane enkulu, uMandi uya kukukhokelela kunyango lwengcali.

q44.text: Impembelelo kwiimpawu zokwenza umsebenzi wakho — ugxininiso, ukuvelisa, okanye ukuzithemba emsebenzini

q46.text: Impembelelo kubudlelwane bakho nentsapho — abantwana, abazali, izihlobo ezisondeleyo

q47.text: Impembelelo kubomi bakho boluntu — ukuzifihla, ukungafuni ukuphuma

q48.text: Impembelelo ekuhlaleni ukhona kwaye uthatha umzekelo

q49.text: Xa ucinga ngokuthi ubufumana ntoni — yintoni imvakalelo yakho?
q49.a: Kukho into engalunganga ndifuna uncedo ngoku.
q49.c: Ndizamile yonke into. Akukho nto isebenzayo kum.

q50.b: Ndikhetha iindlela zendalo — amayeza, indlela yobomi, izongezelelo.
q50.d: Sele ndikuyo i-HRT, okanye sele ndayizama.

q51.text: Uziva njani malunga nenkqubo yezonyango xa kufika empilweni yakho?
q51.a: Ndimthembile ugqirha wam — ndifuna nje ukuthunyelwa kakuhle.
q51.c: Ndikhetha ukuphandafunda kuqala phambi kokuya kugqirha.

q52.text: Wakhe waziva uneentloni okanye uneziva ngoko ubufumana?

q53.text: Uyaziva ngamanye amaxesha ukuba kungase kuselwephuma ngokufumana uncedo — ukuba ulahlekelwe yithuba?

q54.text: Ngaba unezimo zempilo ezikhoyo ezikwenza ukhathazeke ngonyango lwehormone?
q54.hint: Khetha konke okusebenzayo. Impendulo yakho inceda uMandi akukhokelele kunyango oluthe kanye.

q55.b: Yazi ukuba oko ndiziva ngako kuyinto eqhelekileyo.
q55.d: Fumana ugqirha othetha ulwimi lwam neziqonda ii-hormone.
q55.e: Into endingayithatha ndise kugqirha wam okhoyo.

q56.hint: Le into inceda thina siqonde indlela abafazi abaviwa ngayo ngeli qonga.

questionnaire.quiltHeading: Ingubo yakho ukuza kuthi ga ngoku
questionnaire.blanketCompleteBody: Isicwili ngasinye yinto oyabelaneyo. Le ngubo yeyakho — inxalenye yale yothungwayo ngabo bonke abafazi baseMzantsi Afrika kunye.
questionnaire.resumeBody: Ingubo yakho ilindile — {{progress}} sele zithungiwe. Ungaqhubeka apha kanye apho uphezele khona.

facts.context: I-perimenopause — iminyaka yotshintsho phambi kokuba iimeko zenyanga ziphele — idla ngokuthatha malunga neminyaka emi-4 ukuya kwesi-8, nangona kwabanye abafazi imfutshane okanye inde. I-menopause ngokwayo lusuku olunye nje.
facts.mind-cognition: Inkungu yengqondo yenye yeempawu eziqhelekileyo ze-menopause — ibangelwa kukutshintsha kwe-oestrogen, kungenxa yokuba uphulukene nokukhanya kwakho. Kuninzi lwabafazi, iyaphakama.
facts.mood: Utshintsho lweemvakalelo kwi-menopause lolomzimba, ayikokusilela komntu. I-oestrogen isebenzisana ne-serotonin, enye yeekhemikhali zemvakalelo zengqondo — ngoko xa amanqanaba ee-hormone etshintsha, iimvakalelo nazo zinokutshintsha.
facts.nervous-system: Ukushushuziswa kunokuqala iminyaka phambi kweenyanga zakho zokugqibela. Ukuya kuma-8 kwabafazi abali-10 banakho ukufumana oku — nokuba uziva ntoni, awukho wedwa kwaphela.
facts.body: Iintlungu zamalungu nezihlunu luphawu lwe-menopause olungaqondwa kakhulu — i-oestrogen inceda amalungu ahlale evakala kakuhle. Nokuqhuma kwegxalaba kunxulunyaniswa nale ntshintsho.
facts.urogenital: Ngokwahlukileyo kushushuzisweni, iimpawu zangaphakathi nezesidlele azidhli ngokwazo — kodwa ziphendula kakuhle kunyango. Akukho nto ekufuneka uneentloni ngayo.
facts.other: Awusakwazi ukunyamezela utywala njengangaphambili? I-oestrogen isebenzisana ne-histamine — ikhemikhali esemva kokusabela okufana ne-allergy — kwaye abanye abafazi baphawula uvakalelo olutsha kwiminyaka ephakathi. Awuzicingeli nje.
facts.quality-of-life: Iimpawu ze-menopause zifika emsebenzini, ekulaleni, nakubudlelwane. Ukuthi loo mpembelelo akuyiyo ukukhalaza — linyathelo lokuqala lokufumana inkxaso elungileyo.
facts.mindset: Akuze kube semva kwexesha ukucela uncedo. Ezinye iimpawu — kuquka ezesini nezesinyi — zisabela kakuhle kunyango nokuba kudlule iminyaka emingaphi ukususela kwi-menopause.

roadmap.title: Ihlelo lakho leMandi
roadmap.blanketCaption: Isicwili ngasinye yinto oyabelaneyo namhlanje — ibali lakho, libanjwe ndawonye.

mild.label: Iimpawu zokuqala
mild.line: Iimpawu zakho zikhona kodwa zinokulawuleka. Eli lixesha elilungileyo lokwazi nokuthatha amanyathelo athambileyo.

moderate.label: Utshintsho lwehormone oluqhubekayo
moderate.line: Iimpawu zakho zichaphazela ubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla. Ufanele inkxaso eyiyo — kungekho ukuxelelwa ukuba uzinyamezele.

significant.label: Impembelelo enkulu
significant.line: Iimpawu zakho zinempembelelo enkulu ebomini bakho bemihla ngemihla. Ufanele inkxaso ngoku — kwaye ungayifumana.

sally.headline: Bewufuna. Nazi iimpendulo zakho.
sally.body: Oko uvayo kuyinyaniso. Kunegama. Kwaye kukho inkxaso ekhoyo kuwe — eqala namhlanje.

olga.headline: Kunokuba kukho okungaphezu kunokuba ubucinga.
olga.body: Iinto ezininzi obuzicinga zibangelwa luxinzelelo okanye kukukhula ziimpawu eziqondiweyo zotshintsho lwehormone.

vicky.headline: Ufanele ukuviwa — nokuncedwa.
vicky.body: Ukuba bekuthethelelwa wena ngaphambili, kwakungalunganga oko. UMandi uya kuhamba kunye nawe ukuya kunyango oluyiyo.

nelly.headline: Wazi okuninzi. Naku okushiwo lubungqina lwakutshanje.
nelly.body: Uphando lwakho lukukhonzile kakuhle. UMandi uya kuqinisekisa ukuba intetho yakho elandelayo iqondwa ngokupheleleyo.

nina.headline: Iimvakalelo zakho zemzimba zinikezelekile.
nina.body: Kukho indawo yendlela yobomi nendawo yamayeza. Ihlelo lakho lihlonipha zombini, kunye.

retha.headline: Akukho lemva ukuziva bhetele.
retha.body: Ubungqina mayelana nongenelelo emva kwexesha luncomekile ngakumbi kunokuba unokuva. Zikho iindlela ezifanele ukuphandwa.

colleen.headline: Imeko yakho ifuna izimvo zengcali.
colleen.body: Ngembali entsonkothileyo, unyango oluyiyo luthetha ugqirha olungele — ovaqondayo zonke izimo zakho nehormone yakho.

selfHarm.title: Oko uthethileyo kufuna inkalipho.
selfHarm.body: Awukho wedwa kule nto — kwaye akufuneki uyijongane wedwa. Nceda uthethe nathi. ISouth African Depression and Anxiety Group ikhona 24/7.

colleen.title: Kucetyiswa unyango lwengcali.
colleen.body: Ngenxa yembali yakho yezonyango, ihlelo lakho liphendule ekukubeke nengcali enokulawula impilo yakho yehormone kunye nezimo zakho ezikhoyo. Isikhokelo se-HRT ngokubanzi sisesibini apha — ukhuseleko lwakho luza kuqala.

book-first.title: Bhukha ulwalathiso
book-first.body: Ngokusekelwe koko uthethileyo, ukuthetha kugqirha onolwazi nge-HRT linyathelo elibalulekileyo elilandelayo. Fumana othetha ulwimi lwakho neziqonda iihormone.

education-first.title: Qonda okwenzekayo
education-first.body: Qala ngokuyintloko — indlela utshintsho lwehormone olubonakala ngayo, kwaye kutheni iimpawu zakho zinengqondo.

normalise-first.title: Awukho wedwa kule nto
normalise-first.body: Yiva kubafazi abanye baseMzantsi Afrika ababekhona kanye apho ukhoyo — kwaye bafumene indlela yokuphuma.

options-first.title: Yazi iindlela zakho
options-first.body: I-HRT efanayo nomzimba, iindlela zobomi, unyango oluhlanganisiweyo — qonda okufumanekayo nokuthethwa bubungqina.

clinic-first.title: Fumana ulondolozo kufutshane nawe
clinic-first.body: Khangela isikhokelo sethu sabaququzeleli abafanele i-HRT — sikhethwe ngokwemilo yakho nendawo, kuquka i-telemedicine.

download-first.title: Yithathe uye nayo kugqirha wakho
download-first.body: Khuphela isishwankathelo seliphepha elinye seempawu zakho, iMenoScore, nemibuzo onokubuza — uxwebhu olutshintsha ulwalathiso lwakho.

feedback.title: Eli hlelo livakala lilungele wena?
feedback.missing: Ngaba ikho into obulindele ukuyibona ekungekhoyo?
feedback.thanks: Enkosi — kunceda thina ukwakha into engcono komnye umfazi oza kuthi gqi.

signup.title: Joyina iMandi.
signup.subtitle: Gcina ihlelo lakho, ulandele iimpawu zakho, kwaye ubone indlela otshintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwexesha.

name.heading: UMandi nguntambo edibanisayo ehamba kuthi sonke.
name.p1: NgesiBhulu, sisifutshane sika-Amanda. NgesiXhosa, sicholwe kuMandisa. Iilwimi ezahlukeneyo, abahlali abahlukeneyo, amava obomi ahlukeneyo — nangoko sikhona apha, sifazi banye, sihamba imizimba enye, sifanele uhoyo olufanayo.
name.p2: Sakhetha igama eliqala ngo-M ukubeka le projekthi kwi-Menopause — ixesha lobomi elixhumise lo msebenzi. Kodwa uMandi wahlala ehlosiwe ukukhula ngaphandle kwesi sahluko sokuqala. Kuba impilo yehormone ayiqali kwaye ayipheli nge-menopause. Luhambo lobomi, kwaye umfazi ngamnye ufanele iqabane elithembekileyo kuxa lonke.

story.heading: Eli qonga lazalwa kwibali lobuqu.
story.p1: Kuminyaka yam yokugqibela engama-40, ndaxela ngokubetha kwentliziyo kuboogxa bam ababini abadala emini. Omnye wandicebisa ngokukhawuleza ukuba ndibone ingcali yentliziyo. Omnye wathi yinxalenye nje yokukhula. Akukho omnye okhankanyile i-menopause. Akukho omnye othe ukubetha kwentliziyo lolunye lweempawu eziqondwayo ezingaphezu kwe-100 zotshintsho lwehormone. Bendingenalwazi.
story.p2: Kungekudala emva koko ndafudukela eKapa kwiminyaka engama-50, ndilungele iindawo ezitsha ezimnandi. Endaweni yoko, ndaphelela esibhedlele ngosulelo lwesiqonyo olukhulu olubangelwa lusulelo lwesidlele. Ndabonana nogqirha wezesidlele. UGP wam. Ugqirha wabasetyhini. Akukho omnye obunzulu ngokuba ndikuyo na i-HRT. Akukho omnye odibanise iintsulelo zam eziphindaphindayo neehormone zam — nokuba unxulumano luqondiwe kakuhle. Belingaphephi iimpawu zam, kungekho isizathu.
story.p3: Ndandule ndinyamezela iminyaka yeentlungu zamalungu, inkungu yengqondo, utshintsho lweemvakalelo, iiUTI, isondo elibuhlungu, ukushushuziswa, amehlo omileyo, neempawu ezininzi.
story.p4: Ndandule ndaya kwi-intanethi. Ndafumana uDr Louise Newson. UDr Mary Claire Haver. UDr Lisa Mosconi. Nabaninzi. Ndaqala ukuxela bonke abahlobo bam ukuba bafumane uncedo. Umyeni wam undibiza ngokuba ngumvangeli we-menopause.
story.p5: Le into yandikhuthaza ukucebisa uthotho lwedokhumentari kwikykNET olubizwa ngokuba ngu-Meer As Warm Gloede — uthotho lweenxenye ezine olwephehlelwa ngo-Agasti 2026. Lwaphula isithulu malunga ne-menopause kuluntu olutheta isiBhulu, luthetha amabali okwenene avela kubafazi bokwenene, kwaye lunika ababukeli ulwazi nesithembelo sokuthatha impilo yabo ezandleni zabo.
story.p6: Idokhumentari yavula iingcango. Uphando olungaphezulu lwandikhokelele ekufumaneni iMIDI eUnited States — iqonga eliphumelele kutshanje ubume be-unicorn, lusebenzela amakhulu amawaka abafazi kuwo onke ama-50 amazwe. Lo mqondo wabeka into iqalisa.
story.p7: Ngoku ndiqalisa olu hambo nezinye intombi ezimangalisayo ukwakha eyethu yaseMzantsi Afrika: JoinMandi.com.

vision.heading: I-JoinMandi.com ngaphezu kwendawo. Ngumzabalazo.
vision.p1: Yinkolelo yokuba umfazi ngamnye waseMzantsi Afrika — eParow okanye ePolokwane, eSoweto okanye eStellenbosch, nokuba uthetha isiBhulu, isiZulu, isiXhosa, okanye nelinye lweelwimi ezisenza eli lizwe libe yintlanga ekhethekileyo — ufanele aqonde okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakhe, ngolwimi oluvakalayo ngathi sekhaya.
vision.p2: UMzantsi Afrika unolwimi olusemthethweni oluyi-11. Uninzi lwamaqonga empilo edijithali abonelela lunye: isiNgesi. Oku akwanele. UMandi wakhiwe ukukhula kunye nelizwe — kuluntu ngalunye apho abafazi bashiywe ngaphandle kweempendulo eziqondwayo nokukhathalelwa kwezonyango okufanelekileyo.

alone.headline: Akukho mfazi ofanele aziva yedwa, engenalwazi, okanye engaxhasiwe ngexesha le-menopause nangaphaya.

blanket.body: Isikhokelo esikhulu se-Mandi yingubo — ingubo yamalaph ahlukeneyo, izimbo ezahlukeneyo, isiko ezahlukeneyo, athungelwe ndawonye ukwenza into ephelele, efudumeleyo, nentle. Njengoba uMandi. NjengoMzantsi Afrika.

perimenopause.title: Yintoni i-perimenopause?
perimenopause.description: Intshayelelo ecacileyo, esekelwe kubungqina kwiminyaka phambi kwe-menopause — okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakho nokutheni kubalulekile.

symptoms.title: Iimpawu ezingaphezu kwe-100 zotshintsho lwehormone
symptoms.description: Ukubetha kwentliziyo. Iintlungu zamalungu. Inkungu yengqondo. Amehlo omileyo. Esi sikhokelo sigubungela umfanekiso opheleleyo — ukuze kungaphoshwa nto.

bodyIdentical.title: I-HRT efanayo nomzimba ichaziwe
bodyIdentical.description: Iihormone ezifanayo nomzimba yintoni, zahluka njani kwiifomula ezindala ze-synthetic, kwaye yintoni etshiwo bubungqina bangoku.

routes.title: Iindlela zokufaka i-HRT
routes.description: Iiphetshana, iigels, iitabhletti, iisprayi, ezekuvula ngokwesithako — isikhokelo esicacileyo kwiindlela zakho.

mood.title: Iihormone neemvakalelo zakho
mood.description: Uxhalabo, iimvakalelo eziphantsi, nomsindo ovela kungekho ndawo. Qonda unxibelelwano lwehormone — nezinto ezincedayo.

nutrition.title: Ukutya ngempilo yehormone
nutrition.description: Isikhokelo sokutya esisebenzayo kwi-perimenopause nangaphaya — okuthethwa bubungqina malunga nokutya nehormone.

whi.title: Uphando lweWHI — okwenzekileyo ngokwenene
whi.description: Uphando lwe-2002 olwaguqula yonke into — kwaye kutheni izigqibo zacaciswa kakubi. Isishwankathelo esilula.

brain.title: I-Oestrogen nempilo yengqondo
brain.description: Uphando olutsha lwendima ye-oestrogen ekusebenzeni kwengqondo nokubaluleka 'kwexesha elibalulekileyo' lonyango.

resources.notice1: Izixhobo ezingakumbi zongezelelwa rhoqo. Yonke into ihlolwa ngumlingane wezonyango uDr Funeka Bango phambi kokupapashwa.
resources.notice2: Izixhobo zesiZulu nesiXhosa ziyaphuhliswa. Ukuba ungasinceda ekuguquleleni, qhagamshelana nathi.

events.title: Iziganeko zaMandi
events.subhead: Apho uluntu lweJoinMandi luba lwenyani. I-menopause yayiyimfihlo — apha iba luhlanganiseko.

screening.title: Meer as Warm Gloede — Umboniso woLuntu
screening.description: Idokhumentari yekykNET kwiskrini esikhulu. Imiboniso yoluntu ilandelwa yincoko ekhokelwayo — kwindawo ekufutshane nawe.

askspecialist.title: Buza Ingcali ye-Menopause — Bukhona kwi-intanethi
askspecialist.description: I-Q&A ephilayo nogqirha ohlanganisayo. Yiza nemibuzo yakho nge-HRT, iihormone ezifana nomzimba, namanyathelo asebenzayo alandelayo.

cafe.title: IMandi Café — I-Menopause ngeKofu
cafe.description: Akukho jelo, akukho cinezelelo. Bafazi nje bethetha ngokunyaniseka ngemizimba yabo ngekofu. Loer ngalo nalipiphi ixesha.

isizulu.title: Impilo yeHormone ngesiZulu
isizulu.description: Intetho yempilo yoluntu yabafazi baseKZN, ngesiZulu, ezimisela iimpawu zoqalo lwe-perimenopause nase-menopause.

host.heading: Quzelele isiganeko kwiMandi.
host.body: Nokuba ungugqirha wabasetyhini owenza i-Q&A yenyanga, i-NGO equzelela intsasa yoluntu, okanye indawo yomsebenzi exhasa abasebenzi bakho — iziganeko zeMandi liqonga lakho. Yasimahla ukufaka.

principle.line: Uluntu luhlala lusimahla. Ubuchule bunokuthwala intlawulo.

doctor.title: Ulondolozo oluthetha ulwimi lwakho.
doctor.subhead: Oogqirha abafundisiweyo nge-HRT kuMzantsi Afrika — abomtyaba, owoluntu, nabakwi-intanethi. Khetha ngokwephondo, ulwimi, nefomathi.
doctor.empty: Akukho zikliniki zifumanekileyo kukukhetha kwakho. Ezingaphezulu zongezelelwa rhoqo.

newson.note: Ingcali ye-HRT. Unyango lwehormone elifana nomzimba.

hormonal.note: Ingcali ye-menopause. Iincoko kwi-intanethi nase buso ngobuso.

community.note: Ulondolozo lwasimahla okanye olutyalwayo. Indlela yokuthunyelwa iyafumaneka.

bango.blurb: Umcebisi wezonyango kwiJoinMandi. Umququzeleli ofudumeleyo, oqonde ubungqina, ojonge impilo yehormone yabafazi base-Afrika.

vandyk.blurb: GP oqeqeshelwe i-HRT osebenzela eStellenbosch. Ingcali ye-HRT efana nomzimba kunye ne-telehealth kuMzantsi Afrika uphela.

hrt.title: Inyaniso Nge-HRT
hrt.subhead: Uloyiko luhambe ehlabathini ngeeyure ezi-24 ngo-2002. Ulungiso luthathe iminyaka engama-23. Naku okufanele umfazi wonke akwazi — ngesiNgesi esilula.

compare.heading: I-Synthetic kunye nefana noMzimba
compare.intro: Eyona nto ibalulekileyo abafazi abangayaziyo yeyokuba ayikuko ukuba zonke ii-HRT ziyafana. Olu mahluko luphawu lwayo yonke into elandelayo.

synthetic.label: I-HRT esynthetic / engeyiyo eyabantu
synthetic.name: Premarin · Provera
synthetic.body: I-Premarin — eyenziwe ngomchamo wamahashe — iqulethe ii-estrogens umzimba wabantu ongazenziyo ngokwemvelo. I-Provera (MPA) — iprogestin esynthetic. Akuyiyo i-molekyul efana ne-progesterone yabantu.
synthetic.note: Lulo olu uphando lweWHI lwe-2002 olwaluvavanya.

bodyIdentical.label: I-HRT efana noMzimba
bodyIdentical.name: Estradiol · Micronised Progesterone
bodyIdentical.body: I-Estradiol (17β-estradiol) — iguqulwa kwizityalo. Iyafana ngokwekhemikhali ne-oestrogen yabantu. I-Micronised progesterone (Prometrium / Utrogestan) — iyafana ne-progesterone yabantu.

t1992.headline: I-Premarin ifikelela kwincopho.
t1992.body: I-Premarin — eyenziwe ngomchamo wamahashe akhulelwe — iba liyeza eligqibele ekuyalelwa eMelika. Uphando lweWHI luqala, luvavanya iPremarin nePropera kubafazi abali-160,000.

t2002.headline: Uphando olwaguqula yonke into — ngezizathu ezingalunganga.
t2002.body: Uvavanyo lweWHI lumisa kwangoko. Iintloko zehlabathi zibhengeza ukuba i-HRT ibangela umhlaza webele. Ukusetyenziswa kuwa ngama-80%. Ingozi yenene — iimeko ezi-4 kubafazi abayi-1,000 ngeminyaka emi-5 — ayikhankanywa rhoqo. Iziphumo zisetyenziswa kuyo yonke i-HRT, kuquka iihormone ezifana nomzimba ezingazange zaphandwa.

t2003.headline: Izilumkiso ezimnyama zisetyenziswa.
t2003.body: I-FDA isebenzisa izilumkiso ezimnyama kwiklasi yonke kuzo zonke iimveliso ze-HRT — kuquka iihormone ezifana nomzimba ezingazithwele bungqina obunjalo bomonakalo. Isizukulwana sabafazi sityekiselwa unyango ngokusekelwe kwiziphumo ezingasebenzi kubo.

t2008.headline: Isifumaniso esibalulekileyo seFrance.
t2008.body: Uphando lweE3N lufumana ukuba i-progesterone efana nomzimba ayonyusi ingozi yomhlaza webele — ngokwahlukileyo kwi-progestin esynthetic esisetyenziswe kwiWHI. Ingxaki ngo-2002 yayingengeyiyo i-oestrogen — yayiyi-synthetic ekhethekileyo eyasetyenziswa.

t2013.headline: I-Oestrogen yodwa inciphisa ingozi yomhlaza webele.
t2013.body: Ishumi leminyaka yolandela weWHI luqinisekisa ukuba i-HRT ye-estrogen-kuphela inciphisa ngokumandla ukubakhona komhlaza webele nokufa. Oku kuphikisana ngqo nomyalezo ka-2002 — kodwa kuthatha iminyaka elishumi ukufikelela kuluntu.

t2015.headline: I-NICE yase-UK icetyisa i-HRT efana nomzimba.
t2015.body: I-HRT efana nomzimba — iiphetshana ze-estradiol okanye igel ene-progesterone emicronised — iba yindlela ecetyiswayo. Izinikezo ze-HRT eNgilane ziqala ukunyuka ukusukela kweli xesha.

t2025.headline: I-FDA isusa izilumkiso.
t2025.body: I-HHS yaseMelika ne-FDA babhengeza ukususwa kwezilumkiso ezimnyama ezibanzi. I-FDA itshilo: abafazi abaqala i-HRT kwiminyaka eli-10 emva kwe-menopause banganciphisa ingozi yentliziyo ukuya kuma-50%, ingozi yeAlzheimer ngama-35%, nengozi yokwaphuka ngama-50–60%.

t2026.headline: Meer as Warm Gloede iyadlala. I-JoinMandi.com iyaphehlelelwa.
t2026.body: Umfazi wonke waseMzantsi Afrika ufanele lo mlando — ngolwimi lwakhe.

sources.heading: Imithombo
sources.disclaimer: Ulwazi lwemfundo kuphela — ngekuko icebiso lezonyango. Xhubela imeko yakho yobuqu nomququzeleli wezonyango ofanelekileyo.

cta.heading: Ikushiya phi le nto?
cta.body: Ufanele iimpendulo ezinyanisekileyo ngolwimi lwakho luvela kubaququzeleli abaqonda impilo yehormone.

mothers.title: Hlonipha Oomama
mothers.subhead: Indawo yokwenyani yeMandi. Ukuhlonipha okuthuleyo, okuzimiseleyo, kobuntu obunzulu kokuba iqonga abafazi abalisebenzisayo namhlanje libekwe esisekelweni esingahlonipanga rhoqo imizimba, amazwi, okanye ukukhetha kwabafazi.

baartman.body: Owayengumfazi waseKhoikhoi owathathwa eMzantsi Afrika ngo-1810 wabukiswa eYurophu njengomboniso woluntu. Wafa eParys ngo-1815, eneminyaka engama-26. Umzimba wakhe wahlala uboniswa eFransi de kwanga-1974. UNelson Mandela wacela ngokusemthethweni ukubuyiselwa kwakhe ngo-1994. Ngomhla we-9 ka-Agasti 2002 — Usuku lukaZwelonke lwaBasetyhini — wagqibela wangcwatywa ngasendaweni yakhe yokuzalwa. Wafika ekhaya. Ungowethu sonke.

anarcha.body: Abafazi abathathu abamnyama abagqilelweyo amagama wabo siyawazi. Phakathi kuka-1845 no-1849 babhanjwa ukunyongulwa kotyando lokuvavanya — uAnarcha wenza ngaphezu kwama-30 otyando ngaphandle kweanaesthesia — njengoba isiseko sezonyango ze-gynaecology zesimanje wakhiwe phezu kweentlungu zabo. Ngo-2021, indawo eziintloko ze-15-feet yamiselwa ngokuhlonipha kwabo. Amagama wabo athethwa ngoku.

finding.heading: Abafazi esisengabafumana.
finding.body: Imizimba yabafazi base-Afrika yayiyimisinyo yophando lwezonyango, ukuvavanya kobukoloniyali, nokungahoyiwa ngokwesimo seenkulungwane neenkulungwane kwilizwekazi. Amabali athile asasifumana. Njengoba siwafumana, siya kuwongeza apha. Ukuba uyalazi ibali eli kufanele libe kweli phepha, sifuna ukuva ngalo.

wall.heading: Wakhe wabethelelwa? Awukho wedwa.
wall.intro: Amabali amafutshane angeniswe ngabasebenzisi beMandi. Izivakalisi ezintathu okanye ngaphantsi. Akakhethwa ukuba bafuna. Kunye, abalingu kuyento eyamandla.
wall.thandi: Kwiminyaka emithathu ndandicinga ukuba ndilahlekelwa yingqondo. Ugqirha wam wathi ndinexhala. Akukho mntu owayethetha nge-menopause.
wall.mariette: Ek het vyf jaar simptome gehad en nie geweet nie. Ek was nie besig om gek te word nie — my hormoon het verander.
wall.nomsa: Umama wam akazange athethe ngale nto. Umama wakhe akazange athethe ngayo. Ndifuna intombi yam ibe namava ahlukileyo.

closing.names: Sarah Baartman. Anarcha. Betsey. Lucy. Nomfazi wonke igama lakhe alizange libhalwe phantsi.
closing.body: Imizimba yabo yathwala umthwalo we-sayensi eyayingakangaqondi ukuba abathathaphela njengabantu. UMandi wakhiwe ngokuhlonipha kubo. Eli phepha liya kuhlala likhula — kuba kukho amagama angaphezulu okuwafumana, nabafazi abaninzi abaza kuviwa.

founder.quote: Eli qonga lazalwa kwibali lam — iminyaka yeempawu apho akukho mntu wazidibanise neehormone zam. Xa wazi ngcono, unokwenza ngcono. Kwaye unokunceda abanye benze okufanayo.

journey.intro: Apha apho uMandi akhumbula okubaluleke kuwe.

roadmap.emptyBody: Chitha imizuzu elishumi noMandi ufumane ihlelo lobuqu — amanqaku, izixhobo, nesishwankathelo esilungele ugqirha esimile kuwe.

tracker.title: Ubuziva njani kuleveki.
tracker.intro: Cofa idot ukuxela inqaku (0 = akukho, 3 = kakhulu).

checkins.title: Indlela uhambo lwakho oluqhubeka ngayo.
checkins.intro: Imizuzwana emibini ethandekayo yokujonga umva — nokujonga phambili.
checkins.threeMonthSub: Uphendlo olupheleleyo. Lifana nesikhumbuzo seNHS / NICE.
checkins.upcomingNote: UMandi uya kukuvelisa xa ixesha lilungile.

footer.privacy: Ubumfihlo bakho — indlela esisebenzisa idatha yakho

mode.title: Ungathanda ukuphendula njani?
mode.tapsSub: Umbuzo omnye ngexesha — ngaphantsi kwemizuzu emibini

capture.marketing: Ewe, uMandi angandiqhagamshelana malunga novavanyo lwam olupheleleyo, imisitho nenkxaso. Ndingatsho nanini na ukuba mayeke.
capture.finePrint: Asisoze sabelane ngeenkcukacha zakho. Ungacela ukuba sicime yonke into nanini na.

chat.greeting: Molo, ndinguMandi. Ndinemibuzo esibhozo ekhawulezayo malunga nendlela oziva ngayo kutshanje — cofa nje impendulo efanelekileyo.

hi.1: Loo mvakalelo yokulahlekelwa ngamagama — ayiyongqondo yakho ekusilelayo.
hi.2: Inkumbulo yakho ayaphukanga. Abafazi abaninzi kakhulu bachaza kanye oku.

hi.1: Ubuthongo kulapho kuqala khona kubafazi abaninzi. Awuwedwa.
hi.2: Umzimba wakho ukugcina uphaphile ebusuku. Oko kubalulekile.

hi.1: Umzimba wakho ukuxelela into ethile — kwaye kufanelekile ukuyimamela.
Ewe — leyo imangalisa phantse wonke umntu.
hi.2: Abafazi abaninzi benza olo nxibelelwano kamva kakhulu.

hi.1: Kulapho iimpawu zifikelela khona ebomini bakho. Kubaluleke kakhulu.

intro.title: Ingubo yakho ibalisa ibali
intro.sub: Skrola uye ezantsi — yonke ilaphu olithungileyo linento yokuthetha.

cute.mind-cognition: Amagama alahlekayo phakathi kwesivakalisi? Awalahlekanga — akwikhefu leti nje.
cute.urogenital: Izinto ekungathethwa ngazo — thina sithetha ngazo.
cute.mindset: Ufikile. Ngowona mthungo mkhulu ke lowo.

hormoneHook.title: Ayinguwe. Zii-hormone zakho.
hormoneHook.body: Phantse yonke into osanda kuyifunda ivela kwii-hormone ezitshintshayo. Ukuziqonda sisitshixo sokuphinda uzive ungowakho — kwaye yiloo nto uMandi ayakhayo: impilo yabafazi enenjongo, engenazintloni, ngolwimi lwakho, ngelizwi lase-Afrika.

none.title: Ingubo yakho ibonakala izolile — unethamsanqa!
none.body: Akukho zimpawu zinamandla namhlanje. I-menopause ifika ngokwahlukileyo kumfazi ngamnye — kwaye ukwazi omawukhangele kuyeyona ntshayelelo ilungileyo ikhoyo.

consent.title: Incasa ekhawulezayo kaMandi
consent.body: Imibuzo esibhozo ethambileyo, ngaphantsi kwemizuzu emibini. Akukho nto igcinwayo ngaphandle kokuba ukhethe ukushiya i-imeyile yakho ekupheleni.

reveal.heading: Ingubo yakho, ukuza kuthi ga ngoku

band.mild: Iimpawu zakho zibonakala zilula — ukuhlala unolwazi lelona nyathelo lilandelayo lilungileyo.
band.moderate: Iimpawu zakho zibonakala ziphakathi — awuzicingeli nje, kwaye awuwedwa.
band.significant: Iimpawu zakho zibonakala zinzulu — ugqirha oyiqondayo i-menopause unokutshintsha yonke into.

email.title: Goduka nengubo yakho
email.body: Shiya i-imeyile yakho uMandi uya kukuthumelela iziphumo zakho — kwaye akwamkele kuhambo ngexesha esisungula ngalo.
email.consent: Gcina i-imeyile yam neempendulo zedemo ukuze uMandi andithumelele iziphumo zam neendaba zokusungulwa.

thanks.title: Sala kakuhle, okwangoku.
thanks.bodyKiosk: Enkosi ngokuthunga nathi — nceda ubuyisele ithebhulethi.
thanks.bodyPhone: Jonga ibhokisi yakho ye-imeyile. Ingubo yakho epheleleyo — kunye nombutho wempilo yabafazi onelizwi lase-Afrika — ikulindile ku-joinmandi.com.
